author: hikrisdopl
content: They are standardized tests American high schoolers and international students trying to go to universities in the U.S. take. For most schools you don’t need to submit scores but most people do take the ACT or SAT because it’s a test which can show how you compare to your pears. The ACT is out of 36 and consists of 4 sections, English, math, reading, science. The SAT is out of 1600 and consists of reading/writing and math but each has 2 modules. It’s basically just something you put on your college application which allows the college to get a gauge of how you compare to others.
